title: Government Formulating National Steel Policy 2047 as Steel Capacity Crosses 220 Million Tonnes
dek: The government is formulating a National Steel Policy 2047 as India's steel capacity crosses 220 million tonnes, according to KNN India.
summary: According to KNN India, the government is drafting a National Steel Policy 2047, with steel capacity having crossed 220 million tonnes. The publisher's excerpt does not give the policy's targets or timeline.
keyFacts: Government is formulating National Steel Policy 2047
India's steel capacity has crossed 220 million tonnes
whyItMatters: A new long-term policy framework could set capacity, raw material and decarbonisation targets that shape investment across the sector.
implications: Producers and investors should track consultations on the policy, as its provisions could influence expansion and raw material strategies.
